status: FROZEN once frozen_manifest.json is committed; changes need a new version and owner approval
supersedes: phase3_validation_thresholds.md v1 (2026-11-25, T1=100 trades, T4=30 %, T5=1.2)

periods.rationale: Chosen from data availability (all 8 pairs listed from 2020-09-30) and calendar half-year boundaries BEFORE any return was computed. Evaluation = exactly nine 6-month walk-forward windows.

costs.model: fee passed to Freqtrade (--fee, per side) + slippage applied afterwards to fill rates; never both in one parameter
assumptions: 0.10 % taker fee is an assumption for a regular OKX spot tier (not verified here)
slippage is a flat assumption, not measured; orders are tiny versus 1h volume of these pairs
slippage is applied to executed trades and not fed back into Freqtrade position sizing

benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of all pairs listed at the start of the period, same costs, never rebalanced, valued at liquidation value

T10.bias: lookahead and recursive clean on all bias periods

holdout_criteria.rule: Evaluated ONCE, only for strategies that passed T1-T10 on the evaluation period, with files identical to frozen_manifest.json. Holdout results never feed back into any rule, parameter or threshold.

robustness.method: one parameter at a time moved to each end of its allowed range, others at the fixed value
